definitionZh: 内容 CSS 属性以生成值替换内容 。 它可用于定义在元素或伪元素内得到的东西. 对于元素,内容属性指定该元素是正常地(正常的还是没有的)还是被图像(以及相关的"alt"文本)所取代. 对于伪元素和边框,内容将内容定义为图像,文本,两者皆为,或无,决定元素是否完全成型.
sourceDefinition: The content CSS property replaces content with a generated value. It can be used to define what is rendered inside an element or pseudo-element. For elements, the content property specifies whether the element renders normally (normal or none) or is replaced with an image (and associated "alt" text). For pseudo-elements and margin boxes, content defines the content as images, text, both, or none, which determines whether the element renders at all.
